What we do

Three disciplines, one workshop.

From a rough idea to a working part — Saravana Engineering covers the full path between drawing and delivery.

Design Engineering

Component and assembly design worked out from your requirement — dimensions, tolerances and material selection resolved before anything is cut.

Concept → Drawing

Mechanical Engineering

Machining and fabrication of mechanical parts — turned, milled and finished to the running tolerance your assembly needs.

Drawing → Part

Prototyping

Fast first-off builds so a design can be checked, fitted and proven by hand before it goes to production quantity.

Part → Proof
Workshop Infrastructure

Precision machines on our shop floor.

Our workshop in Begapalli is equipped with heavy-duty centre lathes, precision engine turning setups, industrial power sawing and high-accuracy pillar drilling.

Operational
Model: Accurate MH-3 Primary Turning

Accurate MH-3 Centre Lathe

Heavy-duty centre lathe equipped with a rigid bedway, heavy multi-speed headstock, and compound slide. Engineered for large-diameter component turning, heavy facing, shaft fabrication, and precision metric/imperial thread cutting.

Heavy Turning & Facing Shaft & Pin Machining Screw & Thread Cutting Large Swing Capacity
Operational
Model: Crown Star Precision Finishing

Crown Star Precision Lathe

High-precision engine lathe set up for close-tolerance finishing, fine grooving, internal boring, chamfering, and single-piece prototyping in brass, copper, bronze, mild steel, and engineering polymers.

Close-Tolerance Turning Fine Grooving & Parting Boring & Chamfering Prototype Component Work
Operational
Model: Crown Plus Stock Cutting

Crown Plus Power Hacksaw

Industrial reciprocating power hacksaw used for rapid, square-cut billet and bar stock sizing. Cuts raw solid rounds, tubes, and flats to exact blank lengths before mounting on the lathe chucks.

Billet & Bar Sawing Square Billet Cutting Multi-Angle Vice Steel, Brass, Copper & Polymer
Operational
Model: MMT Drilling & Tapping

MMT Pillar Drill Press

Heavy-duty industrial column pillar drill with precision spindle indexing, adjustable worktable, and robust machine vice. Handles accurate hole drilling, counter-boring, reaming, and manual thread tapping.

Precision Hole Drilling Reaming & Spot-Facing Thread Tapping Heavy-Duty Table Clamping

About the workshop

Built on Hosur's
manufacturing floor.

Saravana Engineering is a mechanical engineering workshop based in Begapalli, Hosur — a manufacturing belt known for precision machining and auto-component work. The shop takes on design engineering, mechanical engineering and prototyping under one roof, so a part can move from sketch to sample without changing hands between vendors.

Work is turned around on-site and checked by hand before it leaves — the kind of close, small-batch attention that's earned the workshop a 4.8-star rating from its clients.

Service Area

Hosur & surrounding industrial belt

Rajeswari Layout, Begapalli and the wider Hosur manufacturing corridor, Tamil Nadu.
